stops.name: Seven Stars Pub
stops.text: On June 24, 1901, the Seven Stars hosted the historic meeting organized by John Jackson (a former professional footballer and trainer) to establish a new semi-professional football club

stops.name: The Bosun
stops.text: Christmas festivities were in full swing in the Bosun pub in West Street, Brighton. A group of Albion fans were analysing their vocal failings after a visit to Crystal Palace and decided how to put things right. Said Jeff Wells of Bowring Way, Brighton: “At Selhurst Park the Palace supporters started chanting ‘Eagles’ and the volume was so loud that we could not sing anything louder than them.”
